family.description: Confirmatory family for the fused AND+population-count reduction (gf2's avx2_and_popcnt in crates/gf2-kernels-simd/src/x86/avx2.rs, reachable only through gf2_kernels_simd::detect() and through no public gf2-core dispatcher). It is compared against a single-pass scalar control and against the two-pass and_inplace-then-popcount pattern a consumer reaches through gf2-core's public API today, whose temporary buffer allocation and extra pass sit inside the timed body of the whole-consumer cell. No external library in this survey exposes a matching fused AND-popcount operation; findings.md reports that gap rather than substituting a different operation.

effect.rationale: Unused: every cell in this family has objective comparator-gap, which decides against the material-gap threshold, not against a worthwhile speedup.
effect.equivalence_rationale: An arm within a factor 1.05 of gf2's own implementation is not a materially different implementation for any consumer of these leaf kernels, so a cell whose interval lower bound stays above 1/1.05 is reported as not materially different rather than as a gap. The intended margin is 1.05, chosen on consumer benefit. It lies outside the pilot-measured resolution 0.03.
effect.material_gap_rationale: A comparator arm has to run at least 10% faster than gf2's own implementation before replacing that implementation, or moving its dispatch threshold, could repay the maintenance and dependency cost; below that the survey's conclusion is that gf2's existing kernel is retained. The threshold is tied to consumer benefit, not to the noise floor. The pilot receipt dev/bench_results/26465e6c/2026-09-08-26465e6c-and-popcnt-pilot/receipt.json observed a widest relative confidence-interval half-width of 0.0217 in cell and-popcnt-pilot-streaming, which rounds up to a measurement resolution of 0.03. The declared threshold lies outside that resolution.

complexity_budget.maintenance_rationale: This family is a baseline survey: it authorizes no production code change under crates/. It records comparative evidence only; any adoption decision, such as exposing avx2_and_popcnt through a public dispatcher, is a separate, future issue.
